description: Diques de la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by icvficherosweb.icv.gva.es. Dams, albarradas and other hydrological correction works in the Valencian Community. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Dikes of the Comunitat Valenciana" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ICV_CLAS:Medi ambient;Forestal, Forestal, edificios, ICV_CLAS:Medio ambiente;Forestal, Medio ambiente. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
